author: Claude (autonomous PI, second host)
stage: stage 11 -- the deployment-latency ladder, replacing a saturated endpoint

status_of_prior_endpoint.verdict: Saturated. Zero before training and zero after it, for every arm ever measured. No endpoint defined on this cell can rank two policies, so H_C3 and the 'deployment' secondary as previously written are not answerable and are superseded here.
status_of_prior_endpoint.why: It stacks a fixed 60 ms on top of the full six-channel envelope, moving two axes at once, and 60 ms fixed on all five actuator groups is far harsher than the 0-40 ms sampled independently per group that training ever sees.

design.other_channels: nominal (tracking/lucid_eval_clean) -- latency is the only axis that moves
design.training_envelope_for_reference: 0-40 ms sampled independently per actuator group
design.why_these_arms: the untrained reference, the no-DR control, the standard DR baseline, the LUCID-S proposal, and the capped proposal whose whole point is that it trained on *less* latency than the others and must be shown to pay for that here if it pays anywhere
design.panel: the same frozen 102-motion content-dev partition, eval seeds 8700-8702

hypotheses.H_D1: there is a cliff, and it is inside the training envelope: at least one arm falls below 20% success at a rung <= 40 ms while exceeding 60% at 10 ms.
hypotheses.H_D2: DR training buys latency margin the released policy does not have: the best trained arm exceeds the untrained origin by >= 10 pts at the 20 ms rung.
hypotheses.H_D3: the latency cap costs latency margin: ta_lucid_50_latcap_s4_rg is below ta_lucid_50_s4_rg at the 40 ms rung. This is preregistered as the expected DIRECTION of a trade, not as a failure -- the cap trains on 0-20 ms and 40 ms is outside it.
hypotheses.H_D4: no arm rescues 60 ms: every arm scores < 10% at the 60 ms rung, confirming the saturated cell was measuring a real wall rather than a bug.

decision_rules.seed_agreement: >= 2 of 3 seeds for any directional claim
decision_rules.this_is_a_measurement_change_not_a_hypot: The ladder replaces a saturated instrument. It is declared here, before it is run, with the saturation evidence that motivates it. The AUC primary and every other preregistered endpoint from stages 8 and 9 are untouched.
decision_rules.if_H_D4_fails: then something does clear 60 ms and that arm is the headline deployment result; report it as such and re-examine why the combined cell read zero.

not_yet_verified: all; written before any ladder cell was run
